main_body: Dark grey rune stone slab, rounded-top stele with cyan rune glyphs on the front
top_band: rows 7-10 (4 rows) L=92 #5c5a64, a lighter grey band under the outline, but it is the same width as the body and only a straight slab cap with rounded corners; it reads as a cap on a front face
evidence: Column scan at x=8 shows an outline at row 6, a 4-row lighter band at rows 7-10 (L=92), a dark line at row 11 as the front edge and shadow, then a flat front face at rows 12-30 (L=69) with cyan runes painted flat. The cap is the same width as the shaft with only slightly rounded corners, not an ellipse or a plate wider than the shaft. This matches the red flat-band cap of the guide: a rectangular band over the body with no overhang. The tone step is 92 vs 69, about 23 L, which is under the 25 L threshold, so the band belongs to the front face. The runes are flat and not recessed. Fails as a front elevation.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 5 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, and a median of 5 colours per tile against 17-20. Its dark edge pixels are 100% neutral, so the outline is a near-black sticker line, while the references are 1% and 33% neutral. The body is a nearly flat dark grey with only a lighter cap and a few cyan glyph pixels, with no grain, chisel marks or stone shading. This is much shallower than the reference pieces.
